summary: C5: pro picker UI in /settings + /api/preferences validation
description:
Pro-only model picker on /settings (BRD §7.3). Native HTML, four
radio options. Each row reads '<provider> — <resolved id>' so the
user always sees the actual model — when operator bumps the map,
the UI label updates with no copy migration.

Files:
  - src/app/(app)/settings/page.tsx — new 'Model' section
    rendering CURATED_MODELS entries. Resolved ID rendered from
    the const at render time.
  - src/app/api/preferences/route.ts (extend) — accept
    preferred_model in PATCH body, validate against CURATED_MODELS
    keys, reject other values with 400. Free users may save (it's
    ignored at query time per C3).
  - src/__tests__/preferences.test.ts (extend or new) — round-trip
    write/read; invalid slug rejected with 400.

Picker rendering:
    [○] DeepSeek  — deepseek-v4-pro     cheap, fast            ~$0.005/query
    [○] X.AI      — grok-4.3            mid-cost, fluent       ~$0.015/query
    [●] Anthropic — claude-sonnet-4.6   premium reasoning      ~$0.045/query
    [○] OpenAI    — gpt-5.4             premium                ~$0.040/query

Done when:
  - Pro user sees the four picker options, current selection
    highlighted (DeepSeek default if unset).
  - Selecting another option PATCHes the preference; reload
    persists.
  - Free user sees disabled section + 'Pro only' tag + upgrade
    link.
  - Invalid slug rejected at API with 400.
  - npm run build + npm run lint clean.

Tests:
  - Unit/component: round-trip with mocked fetch.
  - Smoke (manual): pick each of the four, verify chat responses
    attribute correctly (relies on C6).

Operator action post-merge: none.

Depends on: C2 (CURATED_MODELS source), C3 (route reading prefs).

resolution.note: Pro picker UI: four radio rows on /settings showing '<provider> — <resolved id>' so the user always sees the actual model. Free users see disabled rows + Pro-only tag. Optimistic update with rollback on failure. /api/preferences validates preferredModel against isCuratedSlug (already in place from C3); 4 new tests cover accept-valid / accept-null / keep-on-omit / reject-bogus.
